extracted.name: Spicy Bang Bang Shrimp
extracted.description: Spicy Bang Bang Shrimp is a crowd-pleasing appetizer or main dish featuring crispy, golden-fried shrimp tossed in a creamy, sweet, and spicy sauce. The shrimp are coated in a light, seasoned batter and fried until perfectly crunchy, then generously drizzled or tossed with a signature bang bang sauce made from mayonnaise, sweet chili sauce, and a touch of sriracha. Each bite delivers a satisfying crunch with a fiery, tangy kick. Perfect for sharing, serving over rice or lettuce, or enjoying in tacos or sliders.
ingredient_lines: 1 lb raw shrimp (medium or large), peeled and deveined
1/2 cup buttermilk (or milk + 1 tsp lemon juice)
instruction_lines: Clean and pat dry the shrimp with paper towels. In a bowl, marinate shrimp in buttermilk for about 10–15 minutes. This helps the coating stick and tenderizes the shrimp.
In a small bowl, whisk together mayo, sweet chili sauce, Sriracha, and honey. Set aside. Heat 2 inches of oil in a pan or deep fryer to 350°F (175°C).

Remove shrimp from buttermilk and let excess drip off. Dredge the shrimp in the flour-cornstarch mix, coating well. Fry shrimp in batches (do not overcrowd) for 2–3 minutes until golden and crispy. Transfer to a paper towel–lined plate to drain.
Place the fried shrimp in a large bowl. Add the bang bang sauce and toss gently to coat. Serve immediately, garnished with chopped green onions or sesame seeds. Great over lettuce, rice, or in tacos.
